Name: Sapling - New NPC
Author: Robokit12
Description:
[size=3]I highly recommend to start a new save file and backup your current save files BEFORE loading this mod! Your save files might crash after uninstalling this mod!

NOT compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded! 
[/size]
This Sapling simply exists to make your life a lot easier. 

He will make you gifts every day except on Sundays - which may come in handy completing the community bundles.

He´s not on the talkative side, because of lacking a mouth. 
But he´s of friendly nature. 

[b]Hope you enjoy :)![/b]
